remarks: Welcome to 2228 Main Street in Collins! This spacious two story home sits on a generous lot and offers an abundance of space, character, and versatility. The recently updated front sun room creates a warm and inviting first impression. Inside, you’ll find a large dining room, a spacious kitchen with an over sized sliding glass door overlooking the backyard and back deck, and a generous living room featuring glass French pocket doors. The first floor also includes a full bathroom, a bedroom, and a sizable office that could serve as a potential fifth bedroom. Pocket doors throughout the home add character and provide flexibility between living spaces. Two separate staircases lead to the second floor, including one that accesses the primary bedroom. The second staircase leads to an upstairs foyer, a generously sized full bathroom, and three additional bedrooms with great sized closets, including one with a massive walk in closet. A metal roof, approximately five years old, adds another valuable feature to the property. Outside, the expansive backyard offers plenty of space for gardening, outdoor gatherings, recreation, and more. A detached two car garage and additional shed provide extra room for vehicles, tools, equipment, and storage. With its spacious rooms, flexible floor plan, charming details, and generous outdoor space, this property offers plenty of possibilities. Lovingly cared for over the years, this home is ready to welcome its next owner and a wonderful new chapter!
